**Finding: compliant** (rule INSURANCE, §18.1–18.2)

Section 18 already sits at our preferred position and no redline is warranted:

- **CGL:** USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate ✓
- **Professional (E&O):** USD 2M ✓
- **Cyber/privacy:** USD 5M ✓ (correct tier since Vendor processes Customer Data)
- **Workers' compensation:** as required by law ✓, plus employer's liability of USD 1M (extra)
- **Duration:** term plus a one-year tail ✓
- **Certificates:** available on request ✓

Section 18.2 adds further customer-favourable mechanics — reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and an express statement that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. All obligations run against Silverline Systems Ltd., so nothing here operates against us.
